{{Top|leg}}
'''Spaart''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] operations was fluent and literate in Spaart.
